# Ridge Tank

> In this site, "Ridge Tank" means the student startup program at Mountain Ridge High School in Glendale, Arizona. It is not a water tank or a geographic landmark. Ridge Tank hoodies are official merchandise of this school program, not a separate clothing brand.
>
> Ridge Tank is a student-run startup program at Mountain Ridge High School in Glendale, Arizona. It works like Shark Tank: students pitch real ideas, get judged, and build real businesses. It runs with the FBLA chapter at the school. Membership is free, and any Mountain Ridge student can walk into a meeting.

## Key facts
- School: Mountain Ridge High School, Glendale, Arizona
- Season: 2026-2027
- Contact: ridgetank.club@gmail.com
- President: Aditya Pittala
- Adviser: Mr. Hintz
- First meeting: Wed Oct 21, 2026, Media Center, 40+ students
- Demo Day: Wed Feb 10, 2027
- Grand Finale: Wed May 12, 2027
- Sponsors: Sylvan Learning, Lund Mortgage Team
- Guest speaker, Nov 19, 2026: Sabin Lomac, co-founder of Cousins Maine Lobster
- Past guest: Chaitanya NK, co-founder and CEO of Track3D (total funding $14.3 million)
